datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Malawi to assess acute food insecurity conditions and classify geographic areas using the IPC classification scale. Medium-term projections were generated for three periods in 2017 (February, June, October) under different scenarios to estimate food insecurity severity and spatial distribution.
